core.summary: Connects observations, knowledge, models, and decisions.
core.body_preview: Calyrai core is the central reasoning engine of the ecosystem. It links observations, knowledge representation, learning workflows, surrogate models, and decision support into a unified framework.

aflowtex.title: aflowtex
aflowtex.summary: Patient-specific flow modelling and clinical decision support.
aflowtex.body_preview: Aflowtex combines clinical data, vascular modelling, flow simulation, and surrogate reasoning to support patient-specific analysis and uncertainty-aware medical decisions.

lithos.title: lithos
lithos.body_preview: Lithos translates model outputs into actionable decisions by evaluating consequences, risks, trade-offs, and long-term system effects.

oracle.title: oracle
oracle.summary: Extracting knowledge from complex information spaces.
oracle.body_preview: Oracle transforms biological, technical, scientific, and cultural datasets into structured knowledge graphs, reasoning paths, and machine-readable representations.

delphi.title: delphi
delphi.summary: Entry point into Compass for guided knowledge exploration.
delphi.body_preview: Delphi is the platform tile that links into the Compass interface for navigating knowledge, discovering patterns, and generating insights from oracle-generated knowledge structures.
